sources.entry: Profisor - Switch Xcode provisioning profiles for the current project from the menu bar. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/yefga/Profisor) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Profisor is a lightweight macOS menu bar app that lists local provisioning profiles and applies one to the current Xcode project with a click.
summary.what_it_does: Profisor scans the .mobileprovision files stored on your Mac and shows them in a menu bar popover. It ranks each profile against the current Xcode project's bundle ID and team, with badges such as Recommended, Compatible, and Possible match. Expired and soon-to-expire profiles are flagged. You can apply a profile to the current project from the menu bar, with a confirmation sheet before risky applies and a one-click revert. You can also copy a profile's name, UUID, bundle ID, team ID, or file path, and move a profile to the Trash. The README says all scanning and matching happen locally, with no network requests and no stored credentials.
use_cases: switch xcode provisioning profile without opening signing settings
find which profile matches my bundle id
copy profile UUID for Tuist or XcodeGen config
revert a signing change in an Xcode project
notable: Ranks profiles by compatibility with the current project's bundle ID and team
Runs entirely locally with no network requests
Copies profile identifiers for use in Tuist, XcodeGen, or manual signing
Installable through a Homebrew cask or a DMG download
caveats: The first launch may need a right-click Open because the app is not identified by macOS
The README does not describe a Windows or Linux version
